bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing yet. Finished automations, downloads, and anything that needs you will show up here.

destinations.title: Email, push, and webhooks
destinations.description: Send notifications to your email, to your phone or computer with ntfy, or to a service you run. Every notification is still in the bell. A delivery that fails is tried again after 1, 5, and 30 minutes, without running the task again.
destinations.confirmSecret: Make a new signing secret? The old one stops working at once.
destinations.confirmRemove: Remove “{{name}}”? Notifications waiting for it are not sent.
destinations.secretOnce: Signing secret, shown this once. Use it to check the Toskar-Signature header:
destinations.name: Name
destinations.ntfyIntro: Install the ntfy app (Android, iPhone, or ntfy.sh in a browser) and subscribe to the topic below. ntfy is free and open source; you can also run your own ntfy server.
destinations.stored: Stored. Leave blank to keep it.
destinations.onlyIfNeeded: Only if your topic needs one
destinations.contentAuto: Automatic (private on ntfy.sh, full on your own server)
destinations.contentPrivate: Only “You have a new Toskar notification”
destinations.ntfyPublic: On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic can read it, so keep the random topic or send only the private notice.
destinations.webhookHint: HTTPS, or HTTP on this computer or your local network. Each request is signed; the secret is shown once after you add it.
destinations.digestHint: Errors still go out right away. Everything else waits for one message a day.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Desktop notices, email, push, and webhooks wait until quiet hours end. They are in the bell at once.

notices.modelReadyBody: {{model}} finished downloading and is ready to use.
notices.modelExportedBody: {{name}} is ready to download as a GGUF file.
notices.aiDeployedBody: It is now in the Chat model menu and the API.
notices.computerPairedBody: It can now run work with this computer.
notices.computerOfflineBody: Work that needs it runs on another computer, or waits until it is back.
notices.computerOnlineUnnamed: A paired computer is back online
notices.modelCrashingBody_one: It stopped {{count}} time in the last {{minutes}} minutes. Chats answered on another model.
notices.modelCrashingBody_other: It stopped {{count}} times in the last {{minutes}} minutes. Chats answered on another model.
notices.modelCrashingMemory: It is probably running out of memory: close other apps, or choose a smaller model.
notices.toolsSkippedBody: These need your approval, so the run went on without them. Open the automation and allow them to let later runs use them.
notices.automationFailedInARow_one: Could not run ({{count}} failure in a row):
notices.automationFailedInARow_other: Could not run ({{count}} failures in a row):
notices.automationOutOfMemory: This computer ran out of memory for the model.
notices.automationPausedMemory_one: Paused after running out of memory {{count}} time in a row. Choose a smaller model for this automation, or close other work, then resume it.
notices.automationPausedMemory_other: Paused after running out of memory {{count}} times in a row. Choose a smaller model for this automation, or close other work, then resume it.
notices.automationPausedFailures_one: Paused after failing {{count}} time in a row. Check the reason above, fix it, then resume it.
notices.automationPausedFailures_other: Paused after failing {{count}} times in a row. Check the reason above, fix it, then resume it.

sent.privatePush: You have a new Toskar notification.
sent.footer: Sent by Toskar. Change what is sent in Settings → Notifications.
